readout_other: active place avoidance (APA) spatial learning test; hippocampal slice field-potential LTP recording; western blot (NR2B, pNR2B, NR2A, ERK, S6); SWATH-MS proteomics; immunofluorescence/immunohistochemistry (DCX, WFA, GFAP, Iba1)
direction_notes: SUS with and without microbubbles restored LTP induction in aged mice; SUS-only also significantly improved spatial learning, increased synaptic NMDA receptor subunit levels/phosphorylation, increased neurogenesis, and reduced perineuronal net density, consistent with an overall potentiating/excitatory effect on synaptic plasticity.
safety_notes: Thermal testing with a gray-matter mimetic showed a maximal temperature rise of ~1.1°C at the skull, far below the 43°C tissue damage threshold, and quantitative proteomics showed no increase in heat-shock proteins compared to sham, supporting the absence of heat-related bioeffects.

exposures.label: Scanning ultrasound (SUS) whole-brain treatment, with (SUS+MB) or without (SUS-only) microbubbles

target.label: the transducer sonicates a large area of the mouse brain during each treatment; a motorized positioning system moves the focus of the transducer array in a grid such that the ultrasound is delivered sequentially to the entire brain

timing.protocol_description: The motorized positioning system moved the focus of the transducer array in a grid with 1.5 mm between individual sites of sonication so that ultrasound was delivered sequentially to the entire brain. The animals all underwent a weekly treatment for six weeks prior to behavioral testing. A sub-experiment also tested one session (Single SUS, N=8) or three sessions (Triple SUS, N=8) versus the six sessions used for the main SUS-only cohort.

flags.reason: Ultrasound-exposed cohorts (SUS+MB N=15, SUS-only N=20, Single SUS N=8, Triple SUS N=8) are given as separate group sizes; paper does not state a combined total and Single/Triple SUS sub-cohorts may or may not overlap with the main SUS-only group.
0.7 MPa peak rarefactional pressure is stated as the delivery parameter without specifying whether it is a free-field or in-situ (brain) value.
Pulse duration is not stated directly; only PRF (10 Hz) and duty cycle (10%) are given, from which a pulse duration is computable but not reported by the paper.
Main cohorts (SUS+MB, SUS-only) received 6 weekly sessions, but a sub-experiment also tested 1 and 3 session protocols in separate cohorts (Single SUS, Triple SUS).
